findings.title: New sessions/*.log are never pruned by tidy
findings.detail:
Only the old runs/*.log are listed by listRunTraces; logs in sessions/ grow without bound as before. Outside this slice's ACs (logs were never pruned before), recorded by implement as a follow-up.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: File a follow-up to prune sessions/<run>.log with its run under the same D12 window.
